test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_estimate_target (k UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_estimate_target SELECT number % 1000, concat('region_', toString(number % 16)) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4')(s) FROM t_estimate_target FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 'String')(s) FROM t_estimate_target FORMAT Null
SELECT estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 'LowCardinality(String)')(s) FROM t_estimate_target FORMAT Null
SELECT k, estimateCompressionRatio('LZ4', 'LowCardinality(String)')(s) FROM t_estimate_target GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
